body:
Source: GitHub issue #671 (bug, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ e4a62e78: packages/lesson-foundry/bin/lesson-foundry.mjs:51. `loadFindings` calls `core.readEntries`, which returns `{ entries: [], skipped: [] }` when the ledger file does not exist. Running `--gate` with an absent ledger (or a mistyped `--ledger findigs`) prints `no clusters meet the minimum size threshold.` / `done.` and exits 0 instead of flagging that the ledger was not found.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/lesson-foundry`: `bin/lesson-foundry.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/foundry.mjs`, `lib/gate.mjs`, `lib/cluster-id.mjs`, `lib/finding-hash.mjs`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry` from the worktree root.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `bin/lesson-foundry.mjs`: When `--gate` is set, check whether the resolved ledger file exists. If it does NOT exist and `!values['allow-missing-ledger']`, fail with `opError('ledger file not found: ' + resolvedPath)` (exit 1).
2. Add CLI flag `--allow-missing-ledger` for the bootstrap / initial setup case where no ledger exists yet.
3. When `--gate` is NOT set (plain dry-run / info mode), missing ledger continues to return empty entries without error.
4. Documentation: update `packages/lesson-foundry/README.md`, `docs/tools/lesson-foundry.md`, and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/lesson-foundry.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `lesson-foundry --gate --ledger nonexistent` exits 1 with operational error naming ledger file not found. verify: `node --test packages/lesson-foundry/test/missing-ledger-gate.test.mjs`
- AC2 `lesson-foundry --gate --allow-missing-ledger --ledger nonexistent` exits 0 (bootstrap opt-in works). verify: `node --test packages/lesson-foundry/test/missing-ledger-gate.test.mjs`
- AC3 Existing test suite passes with no regressions. verify: `npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry`
- AC4 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "allow-missing-ledger" packages/lesson-foundry/README.md docs/tools/lesson-foundry.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/lesson-foundry.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC5 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Clustering algorithm changes or changing default ledger name.
title: lesson-foundry: fail with opError when --gate ledger is missing unless --allow-missing-ledger is set
